runs.text: Heuristic selection of the longest instruction-response pairs consistently outperforms complex methods by capturing rich learnable signals.
LLM-as-a-judge frameworks automatically filter low-quality instances, yielding superior performance with reduced training costs.
Existing methods often disregard linguistic specificities and suffer from cross-lingual biases when using general-purpose judges.
We propose fine-tuning a multilingual expert model and applying Maximal Marginal Relevance to balance data quality and diversity.
